name: checkwise-ehs
description: CheckWise EHS - Enterprise checklist generator and inspection platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix server install
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
